title: On the Distribution of Primes and Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
abstract: We establish analytic continuation of the zeta function and prove the Prime Number Theorem.

sections.heading: 1. Zeta Function Definition
sections.text:
Definition 1.4. The Riemann zeta function zeta(s) is defined for Re(s) > 1 by the Dirichlet series sum n^{-s}.
Remark 3. The non-trivial zeros lie in the critical strip 0 <= Re(s) <= 1.

sections.heading: 2. Prime Number Theorem
sections.text:
Lemma 2.4. The zeta function zeta(s) has no zeros on the line Re(s) = 1.
Theorem 6.1. Theorem 6.1 follows from Lemma 2.4. The prime counting function pi(x) is asymptotic to x / log(x).
Proof of Theorem 6.1. Apply Definition 1.4 and Lemma 2.4 using contour integration.
